segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Hi everyone, aaj senior backend role ka debrief hai, teen candidates final round tak aaye the.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Haan, maine teenon ka system design round liya tha, notes sheet mein daal diye hain.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Pehle Siddharth se shuru karte hain. Nikhil, tumhara kya feel hai?

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Siddharth strong hai. Caching aur queue design pe bahut clear tha, trade-offs bhi khud bole.

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Coding round mein bhi achha tha, bas tests likhne mein thoda slow tha.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: HR round mein bhi theek tha. Uski expectation 26 LPA hai, abhi 20 pe hai.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: 26 thoda upar hai hamare band ke liye. Band ka top 24 hai.

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Mujhe lagta hai 24 pe maan jayega, usko product company mein aana hai.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Haan, call pe usne bola tha ki role zyada important hai, paisa thoda flexible hai.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Theek hai, decide karte hain, Siddharth ko 24 LPA ka offer denge.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Agreed, achha hire hoga.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Doosri candidate Meenal ke baare mein?

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Meenal ka coding achha tha par system design mein bahut generic answers the.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Haan, mujhe nahi lagta woh senior role ke liye ready hai, mid-level ke liye consider kar sakte hain.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Theek, usko mid-level pipeline mein move karte hain, abhi reject nahi karenge.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Teesra candidate ne interview ke beech mein hi withdraw kar liya, counter offer mil gaya usko.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Chalo. Zoya, Siddharth ka offer letter kab tak nikal sakta hai?

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Approval chahiye finance se, phir letter banta hai. Agle Tuesday tak offer letter bhej dungi.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Agle Tuesday theek hai. Uska notice period kitna hai?

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Notice period 15 December tak hai, uske company mein buyout nahi hota.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Matlab joining January ke start mein hogi, theek hai, project bhi tab tak start hoga.

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Ek process wali baat bolun? Take-home assignment pe candidates bahut drop ho rahe hain.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Haan, chaar din ka assignment koi nahi karta jab doosri jagah ek round mein ho jata hai.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Toh kya karein, assignment hata dein?

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Uski jagah ek ghante ka live pairing round rakhte hain, saath mein code karenge.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Pairing mein actually zyada pata chalta hai banda kaise sochta hai.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Theek hai, take-home band, ab se live pairing round hoga.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Main candidates ko bhejne wala email template update kar dungi uske hisaab se.

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Referral bonus ka bhi socho, abhi sirf pachees hazaar hai, pachas kar dein toh referrals badhenge.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Pachas hazaar abhi possible nahi hai, is quarter budget already tight hai.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Haan, finance ne pichhle hafte hi mana kiya tha. Referral wala baad mein dekhte hain.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Haan, referral bonus abhi park karte hain, next quarter mein baat karenge.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Ek aur cheez, careers page pe JD bahut purana hai, abhi bhi purana tech stack likha hai.

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Haan, ek candidate ne bola bhi ki JD aur interview match nahi karte.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: JD update karna padega. Koi bhi kar le, mujhe bas ek draft chahiye review ke liye.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Main is hafte on-call hoon, mujhse nahi ho payega.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Theek hai, koi kar lega, bas careers page pe naya JD jaldi aana chahiye.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Interview panel mein aur log chahiye, sirf Nikhil aur Tarun pe load hai.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Haan, main engineering managers se baat karti hoon, do log aur add karenge.

segments.speaker: Tarun Malik
segments.text: Shukriya, ek hafte mein paanch interview ho gaye the pichhli baar.

segments.speaker: Nikhil Arora
segments.text: Aur scorecard bhi simple karo, das columns bahut zyada hain.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Scorecard pe alag se baat karte hain, aaj ka agenda ho gaya.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Main Siddharth ko aaj ek informal call kar deti hoon ki offer aa raha hai.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Haan, kar do, par number abhi mat batana jab tak approval nahi aata.

segments.speaker: Zoya Khan
segments.text: Bilkul, sirf heads-up dungi.

segments.speaker: Arpita Sen
segments.text: Thanks all, achha debrief tha.

decisions.fact: Siddharth is offered the senior backend role at 24 LPA.
The take-home assignment is replaced by a one-hour live pairing round.
Meenal moves to the mid-level pipeline instead of being rejected.

action_items.fact: Zoya sends Siddharth's offer letter after finance approval.
Someone drafts an updated JD for the careers page; nobody named.

distractors.fact: Raising the referral bonus to Rs 50,000 was suggested and parked.
15 December is the end of Siddharth's notice period, not the offer letter's date.
